item.title: Zenkoji Temple: Nagano's Great Non-Sectarian Pilgrimage Temple — Guide
item.description: Zenkoji is one of Japan’s most important and popular pilgrimage temples, founded in the 7th century and unusual in welcoming worshippers of all Buddhist sects, which helped make it a destination for pilgrims from across the country for centuries. The temple’s grand main hall houses a famous ‘hidden Buddha’, an image never shown to the public, and visitors can walk the o-kaidan, a pitch-black underground passage beneath the main hall where they feel for a metaphorical ‘key to paradise’ in total darkness, one of the temple’s most memorable experiences.
